summary: This makefile target provides a command-line interface for a tags manager tool. If you run it without arguments, it displays helpful usage examples and exits with an error. If you provide arguments via ARGS, it spins up a Docker container with Python and runs the tags-manager script with those arguments.

explanations.1: .PHONY tells Make that 'tags-manager' is not a file we're trying to create, just a command to run.
explanations.4: ifeq checks if the ARGS variable is empty (after stripping whitespace); the code that follows runs only if it is empty.
explanations.21: exit 1 exits with status code 1, which tells the system this command failed.
explanations.22: else starts the section that runs only if ARGS was provided (not empty).
explanations.24: This runs a Docker container that installs two Python packages silently, then executes the tags-manager Python script, passing along whatever arguments were given in ARGS.
